notes.content: The page says that << has no simple direct interpretation in the deployments or multideployment Fig(F), and that G << F does not imply Fig_M(G) << Fig_M(F). It therefore questions the application (**) and the notation beginning '= Fig_M(F)'. Definition (1.33) gives a family of subsets of M with an order << implied by inclusion, written F <= G. The next paragraph announces the role of the (grandes) ombres. The first axiom is revised to a family of preadmissible(s) sets with support M, so that the family determines a preorder in M; the sentence continues on the next page.
notes.math_reading_decisions: All first-paragraph Fig positions were checked: Fig(F) has no visible index; the two terms in the not-implied comparison and the term after '=' have M indices. The literal singular multidéployement is kept after des. There are ten main-text M occurrences, four main-text family F occurrences, one powerset P, and a separately ambiguous marginal f/F/family F/brace. Each differing alphabet occurrence has its own differences row and tight original-image box. The last comparison in (1.33) is F <= G, with an ordinary G. No mathematical correction is substituted for manuscript wording. The two physical superpositions before notée and at the foot retain explicit state alternatives.
